rv.q: In 90 minutes that darken, figuratively and literally, from one kind of dance to another most harrowing, Master Harold captures the evil of apartheid in its most insidious forms: its ruin of black lives but also its corrosive effect on youth, and on hope.

cn.t: Critics praise the glorious Burton Lane-Yip Harburg score and Melissa Errico's luminous performance, though many find the condensed book incoherent and the whimsical 1947 satire an uneasy fit for its intimate staging.
